name: browser-use
headline: Claude skills to creative workflows
short_description: Professional agent skills for Canva designs: resize for social media, bulk-create from data, implement feedback, edit designs, get feedback, and brand-check against kits.
author: canva-sdks

sections.overview:
Canva Claude Skills is a collection of professional agent skills that automate and enhance Canva design workflows. The package includes six active skills: resize-for-social-media creates platform-optimized versions for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn in parallel; bulk-create generates multiple designs from tabular data using brand templates; implement-feedback reads comment threads and applies API-supported changes; edit-design makes approval-gated edits to existing designs; get-design-feedback provides structured critique on visual hierarchy and accessibility; and brand-check compares designs against brand kits. These skills integrate with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, enabling designers and teams to automate repetitive tasks, manage feedback cycles, and maintain brand consistency at scale.
Resize a single design for distribution across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn simultaneously
Generate dozens of product or promotional designs from a CSV or spreadsheet using a brand template
Read and triage design feedback from comment threads, then apply changes automatically
Audit a design against your brand kit to verify color, typography, and logo consistency
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/canva-sdks/canva-claude-skills`
sections.usage:
```
I want to create a social media campaign for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Generate 5 Canva design ideas with descriptions and suggested color palettes. Use the Canva Connector to provide direct design templates.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
